SELECT corpus_id, title, abstract, year, citation_count
FROM Papers
WHERE title ILIKE '%vagina%'
   OR title ILIKE '%labella%'
   OR abstract ILIKE '%vagina%'
   OR abstract ILIKE '%labella%'
ORDER BY citation_count DESC, year DESC
LIMIT 100

query: koren lazar, ancient akkadian texts a masked modelling
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id, p.title, p.abstract, p.citation_count, p.year
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE (
    p.title ILIKE '%koren%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lazar%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%ancient%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%akkadian%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%masked%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%modelling%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%koren%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%lazar%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%ancient%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%akkadian%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%masked%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%modelling%'
)
OR (
    a.name ILIKE '%koren%' OR
    a.name ILIKE '%lazar%'
)
ORDER BY p.citation_count DESC, p.year DESC
LIMIT 100
